name: The Glass Mushroom City
description: A sprawling metropolis built from bioluminescent glass mushrooms, each cap houses a tiny glowing window, streets of crystal pathways, floating lanterns drift overhead.
prompt: A surreal Glass Mushroom City: towering glass mushrooms forming buildings, each cap containing glowing windows, crystal walkways connecting structures, floating lanterns drifting along streets, night sky deep blue, hyperrealistic, fantastical urban landscape.
caption: Welcome to the Glass Mushroom City—where even the smallest dwellings shine with city‑wide brilliance 🌌🏢.
